items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: When Larry had a job to play, he would put Mike on piano and hire me to play trumpet.

ctx.x: Then they have a club out on the airline highway, they call it Cotton Club now. They used to be named. The Rio Rita. The Rio Rita. The Rio Rita. And they wanted to rename the club, so they asked somebody to name the club. And how they rename it up until they did. They still call it Cotton Club. Yeah, still call it Cotton Club. Big club on the airline highway. We used to work there. Yeah. And matter of fact, Mike DeLay was his trumpet player. No, we know how to call him Mike DeLay. Joe Phillip.
Joe Phillip started that with me. Joe Phillip, front of Santiago. Then he left then Mike DeLay.
